recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If a future incorrect draft/status label is found in QI-Core, EHRS, or another external IG, address it in that IG's repository/publication workflow rather than in FHIR core.
issue_request: FHIR-8677 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 change request asking that QI-Core profiles based on draft resources, and implementation guides such as EHRS, be marked as draft.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 6957. The matching git-svn commit af00949c039e6ee26443604d74778b6b5a61b8dd added profile-page draft-note template support and generated draft-note handling based on profile package status, applying the historical DSTU1-era request.
additional_context: Current core source no longer publishes the DSTU1 QI-Core or EHRS guide content from core: source/igs.xml comments out ehrsrle and qicore, and source/fhir.ini active profiles do not include QI-Core or EHRS. Current profile templates use shared standards-status/FMM rendering, active draft resources are listed in source/fhir.ini, and QI Core is referenced as the external http://hl7.org/fhir/us/qicore IG.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Editing current FHIR core source would be incorrect because there is no active core-owned QI-Core/EHRS profile package to mark and active core artifacts already have status rendering.
